about: Alexander Caballero is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Tampa, Florida area. Providing legal representation in Florida for a variety of different issues, Alexander Caballero was selected to Super Lawyers for 2007 - 2026.

After completing undergraduate studies, Alexander Caballero attended law school. Alexander Caballero was enrolled at Florida State University College of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 1993. Alexander Caballero was admitted to the practice of law in 1993.

Attorneys like Alexander Caballero are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Alexander Caballero represents clients with Family Law issues.
